text: Starting cross-server audit; preserving logs and checking services, accounts and scheduled jobs.

Grafana 8.3.1 publicly exposed and vulnerable to plugin file traversal; root sudo rsync to deploy and writable wp-config read by root present privilege-boundary risks.

CI maintenance now runs git GC as repository owner, not root; local root-owned steps retained.

Eliminated root export symlink overwrite race: private root temporary data and output created under requesting user with noclobber.

Observed nvega cleanup included -mtime -8 as well as +7 on db-01; likely destructive cleanup mistake, not by itself evidence of unauthorized access. Encrypted copies on ci-01 remain; monitoring next dump.
Restored local recent dumps and nightly encrypted archives from verified 13:20 encrypted archive after cleanup removed them; ci-01 copies retained.
Restored encrypted archive copies on ci-01 from db-01 after two cleanup commands removed recent and older files on both hosts.
